caption: The drawing features a wooden structure with two vertical side panels and two horizontal planks, one on top and one in the middle, forming a rectangular frame. The wood is rendered in shades of brown with visible grain patterns. Between the top and middle planks, there are six evenly spaced, vertically aligned metallic cylinders, depicted in gray, which extend downward. Underneath the middle plank, each metallic cylinder is capped with a nut-shaped component, adding detail at the bottom ends. The side panels each have a semi-circular cutout at their base, and the drawing is contained within a simple rectangular border. The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner. The background is an off-white or light beige color, kept plain and unadorned.
title: Candle Mold
